draft.title: Laboratory Technician
draft.position_summary: Prepares materials and equipment each semester for experimental work conducted by the students in Engineering Science (ENSC) laboratories. Provides course support by helping to maintain support facilities (e.g. workshop) and by maintaining/repairing equipment, fabricating/developing experimental apparatus, documenting procedures, instructing students and faculty on machine and equipment use and safety procedures. Assists students, faculty, and staff as directed by the Supervisor. Provides support for faculty, staff and building upkeep by preparing purchase orders for parts and equipment, implementing safety procedures, performing monthly safety inspections and monitoring research lab safety inspections, disposing of surplus equipment, assigning offices and office furniture, and being a contact point for Facilities Management, Access Control, and Campus Security.

model.title: Laboratory Technician
model.position_summary: Provides essential technical support for Engineering Science laboratory courses by preparing, maintaining, and repairing equipment and experimental apparatus. The incumbent ensures safe and efficient operation of lab facilities, assists students and faculty with equipment use, and manages inventory, procurement, and documentation. This role also coordinates with facilities services and external vendors to address work orders, safety compliance, and surplus equipment disposal, contributing to the overall quality of hands‑on learning experiences.
